contract_owner.role: read-only sequence, topology, and theorem-interface framing

exact_definitions: def epsilonSeq (epsilon0 : Real) (n : Nat) : Real := epsilon0 / ((n : Real) + 1)
noncomputable def coefficientError (epsilon chi b2 b3 : Real) : Real := Real.sqrt (frobeniusSq (slopeRepresentative (boostedB epsilon chi b2 b3) - slopeRepresentative (boostedB epsilon 0 b2 b3)))
exact_target_signatures: theorem epsilonSeq_pos (epsilon0 : Real) (he0 : 0 < epsilon0) (n : Nat) : 0 < epsilonSeq epsilon0 n
theorem epsilonSeq_tendsto_zero (epsilon0 : Real) : Filter.Tendsto (epsilonSeq epsilon0) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

theorem epsilonSeq_futureUnit_iff (epsilon0 chi b2 b3 : Real) (he0 : 0 < epsilon0) (h2 : 0 < b2) (h3 : 0 < b3) (n : Nat) (v : FourVector) : ((boostedB (epsilonSeq epsilon0 n) chi b2 b3).mulVec v = 0 ∧ FutureUnit v) ↔ v = uChi chi
theorem coefficientError_tendsto_zero (epsilon0 chi b2 b3 : Real) : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : Nat => coefficientError (epsilonSeq epsilon0 n) chi b2 b3) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
theorem uChi_ne_uChi_zero (chi : Real) (hchi : 0 < chi) : uChi chi ≠ uChi 0

semantic_contract.interior: epsilon0>0 implies every epsilonSeq member is strictly positive; zero is only the limit
semantic_contract.endpoint: Do not assign positive-epsilon kernel uniqueness to epsilon=0
semantic_contract.coefficient_metric: Real.sqrt of the source-bound positive Euclidean frobeniusSq
semantic_contract.velocity: uChi chi and uChi 0 are fixed and unequal for chi>0
semantic_contract.sequence_upper_endpoint: epsilonSeq epsilon0 0 = epsilon0; do not claim strict membership below epsilon0

build_plan: Compile exact source chain into one isolated raw/source_root in dependency order: membership, C02, sky, canonical, squared error, span, future unit, then target; use -R for each source directory and LEAN_PATH for imported oleans.

acceptance: Use imported definitions and theorems; do not re-expand the 22/9 identity.
Use the continuous sqrt Tendsto route; do not factor sqrt(epsilon^2*C) without a sign proof.
No endpoint uniqueness claim at epsilon=0.
No sorry, admit, custom axiom, or assumed conclusion.

claim_ceiling.allowed: An explicit strictly positive sequence of unique future-unit kernel representatives has source-bound coefficient error tending to zero while the displayed velocities remain unequal for fixed chi>0.

next_obligation: Prove bounded rapidities and rate amplitudes for the sequence, then state and prove the quantified no-uniform-modulus synthesis.
